name: Sime Darby Property Berhad
summary: Sime Darby Property Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business in Malaysia, Australia, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Property Development, Investment, and Asset Management and Leisure. It develops residential, commercial, and industrial properties; leases properties; and provides assets management services, as well as offers golf and other recreational facilities and services.
